tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background behind everything. The product is dark-first.

tokens.name: surface-1
tokens.usage: Panels: the code panel, sidebar cards, the action bar.

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: Raised objects inside a panel: comment cards, the composer, inputs and segmented-control tracks on surface-1, secondary buttons.

tokens.name: surface-3
tokens.usage: Headers inside a raised object (the 'Suggested change' bar) and the selected verdict row.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Wells set into a raised object: suggested-code bodies, dialog footers.

tokens.name: surface-selected
tokens.usage: The pressed segment of a segmented control.

tokens.name: overlay
tokens.usage: Scrim under dialogs.

tokens.name: border-subtle
tokens.usage: Panel outlines and dividers between panel sections.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Outlines of raised objects: cards, inputs, secondary buttons. Decorative only; not a control boundary on its own.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Control boundaries that must be seen (checkbox box, unselected radio). Meets 3:1 on bg and surface-1 in both themes.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Primary text and headings on any surface.

tokens.name: text-secondary
tokens.usage: Running text inside cards: comment bodies, replies, secondary-button labels.

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Field labels, helper text, unselected segment labels, icon buttons. 4.5:1+ on every surface.

tokens.name: text-faint
tokens.usage: Line numbers, metadata ('You · line 15'), counts. The lowest text contrast allowed: 4.5:1 on bg, surface-1 and surface-2.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Primary button fill. One per view: Publish, Start review, Mark as fixed.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Label and icon on a primary fill.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Focus, the line being commented, switch on-state, links. Never a button fill.

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: Accent as text, e.g. the line number of the line being commented, on accent-soft or surfaces.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Background tint of the line being commented.

tokens.name: accent-border
tokens.usage: Outline of the open composer.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: 2px keyboard focus ring with a 2px bg-colored gap (see shadow-focus).

tokens.name: switch-off
tokens.usage: Switch track when off. On is accent.

tokens.name: switch-knob
tokens.usage: Switch knob in both states.

tokens.name: blocker
tokens.usage: Blocker severity: dots, line marks, gutter stripe. Must fix.

tokens.name: blocker-text
tokens.usage: Blocker label text on blocker-soft or any surface.

tokens.name: blocker-soft
tokens.usage: Blocker badge fill.

tokens.name: blocker-tint
tokens.usage: Background of a code line whose top open comment is a blocker.

tokens.name: issue
tokens.usage: Issue severity: dots, line marks. Should fix. Also the 'Changes requested' verdict.

tokens.name: issue-text
tokens.usage: Issue label text on issue-soft or any surface.

tokens.name: issue-soft
tokens.usage: Issue badge fill, 'Changes requested' pill.

tokens.name: issue-tint
tokens.usage: Background of a code line whose top open comment is an issue.

tokens.name: suggestion
tokens.usage: Suggestion severity: dots, line marks. Worth learning, not required.

tokens.name: suggestion-text
tokens.usage: Suggestion label text on suggestion-soft or any surface.

tokens.name: suggestion-soft
tokens.usage: Suggestion badge fill.

tokens.name: suggestion-tint
tokens.usage: Background of a code line whose top open comment is a suggestion.

tokens.name: nit
tokens.usage: Nit severity: dots, line marks. Style or taste. Also 'Comments only' verdict.

tokens.name: nit-text
tokens.usage: Nit label text on nit-soft or any surface.

tokens.name: nit-soft
tokens.usage: Nit badge fill.

tokens.name: nit-tint
tokens.usage: Background of a code line whose top open comment is a nit.

tokens.name: praise
tokens.usage: Praise severity and every 'done' state: Approved verdict, fixed checkmarks, progress fill, published check.

tokens.name: praise-text
tokens.usage: Praise / fixed label text on praise-soft or any surface.

tokens.name: praise-soft
tokens.usage: Praise badge fill, 'Fixed' button fill, 'Approved' pill.

tokens.name: praise-tint
tokens.usage: Background of a code line whose top open comment is praise.

tokens.name: resolved-mark
tokens.usage: Gutter stripe of a line whose comments are all fixed.

tokens.name: diff-add
tokens.usage: The + sign in diffs and suggested code.

tokens.name: diff-add-bg
tokens.usage: Added-line background in diffs and suggested code.

tokens.name: diff-del
tokens.usage: The − sign in diffs.

tokens.name: diff-del-bg
tokens.usage: Removed-line background in diffs.

tokens.name: syn-text
tokens.usage: Code: identifiers and plain text.

tokens.name: syn-keyword
tokens.usage: Code: keywords (if, return, using, class).

tokens.name: syn-type
tokens.usage: Code: built-in and capitalized types (int, vector, String).

tokens.name: syn-string
tokens.usage: Code: strings, chars, include paths.

tokens.name: syn-number
tokens.usage: Code: numeric literals.

tokens.name: syn-comment
tokens.usage: Code: comments. Still 4.5:1 on surface-1.

tokens.name: syn-preproc
tokens.usage: Code: preprocessor directives (#include, #define).

tokens.name: syn-function
tokens.usage: Code: an identifier followed by '(' (calls and definitions).

tokens.name: syn-operator
tokens.usage: Code: operators and punctuation.

tokens.name: syn-suggestion
tokens.usage: Plain text color inside the suggested-code textarea while editing.

families.mono: "Geist Mono", ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

styles.name: t-display
styles.usage: Review title on the mentee page. One per page.

styles.name: t-title-lg
styles.usage: Editable review title on the mentor screens.

styles.name: t-body-lg
styles.sample: Solid start: the logic is right and the formatting is now consistent.
styles.usage: The review summary on the mentee page. Max 720px wide.

styles.name: t-body
styles.sample: Paste the code you want to review.

styles.name: t-label
styles.usage: Buttons, card headings (Summary, Comments), pane titles.

styles.name: t-caption
styles.sample: 1 blocker is still open. Start there.
styles.usage: Helper text, progress notes, small buttons.

styles.name: t-meta
styles.usage: Field labels, badge text (at 500), metadata, counts.

styles.name: t-micro
styles.usage: Step numbers and avatar initials only.

styles.name: t-code
styles.usage: Code lines and line numbers. Line height is fixed at 20px: gutters and marks align to it.

styles.name: t-code-inline
styles.usage: Backticked code inside prose; pair with the inline-code chip (radius-xs, surface-selected).

styles.name: t-url
styles.usage: Share and edit links, file names.

spacing.note: 4px base. Names are the pixel value, so space-12 is 12px.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between segments in a segmented control; icon-button clusters.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Tight gaps: step chips, toolbar buttons.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Badge dot to label; label to field; between severity chips.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Default inline gap: button groups, header items.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Card header vertical padding; row gap in checklists.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Comment card inner padding; field groups.

tokens.name: space-14
tokens.usage: Panel header horizontal padding; code text inset.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Card padding; gap between sidebar cards; gutter right padding.

tokens.name: space-20
tokens.usage: Page header side padding; dialog padding; gap between main sections.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Page padding; gap between code panel and sidebar.

tokens.name: space-28
tokens.usage: Main content top padding; mentee page section gap.

tokens.name: space-32
tokens.usage: Empty-state padding.

tokens.name: space-40
tokens.usage: Page bottom padding.

tokens.name: space-64
tokens.usage: Mentee page bottom padding.

tokens.name: space-96
tokens.usage: Dialog offset from the top of the viewport.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Inline code chips, checkbox boxes.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Badges, segments, icon buttons, severity chips.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, selects, segmented-control tracks, link fields.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Comment cards and the composer.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Panels and sidebar cards.

tokens.name: radius-2xl
tokens.usage: Dialogs.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Pills, dots, avatars, switches, progress bars.

size.note: Fixed dimensions of controls and layout columns.

tokens.name: control-xs
tokens.usage: Segment buttons, severity chips, small text buttons.

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Mark as fixed, Copy inside a card header.

tokens.name: control-md
tokens.usage: Default button, input, select and icon-button height.

tokens.name: control-lg
tokens.usage: Start review, verdict rows, switch rows.

tokens.name: control-xl
tokens.usage: Full-width Publish, link fields in the dialog.

tokens.name: header-height
tokens.usage: App header minimum height.

tokens.name: icon-sm
tokens.usage: Icons inside 26–28px controls.

tokens.name: icon-md
tokens.usage: Default icon size.

tokens.name: gutter-width
tokens.usage: Line-number gutter; comment cards indent by the same amount.

tokens.name: code-line
tokens.usage: Height of one code line; everything in the gutter snaps to it.

tokens.name: sidebar-width
tokens.usage: Flex-basis of the review sidebar (flex: 1 1 320px).

tokens.name: comment-max
tokens.usage: Max width of comment cards and the composer.

tokens.name: dialog-width
tokens.usage: Max width of the publish dialog.

tokens.name: container
tokens.usage: Max width of the paste screen.

tokens.name: container-wide
tokens.usage: Max width of the review editor.

tokens.name: container-read
tokens.usage: Max width of the mentee page.

tokens.name: shadow-dialog
tokens.usage: Dialogs only. Nothing else in Nitpick casts a shadow: depth comes from surface steps and borders.

tokens.name: shadow-composer
tokens.usage: Soft halo around the open composer, with accent-border as its outline.

tokens.name: shadow-focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus on every interactive element (:focus-visible).

tokens.name: z-header
tokens.usage: Sticky headers.

tokens.name: z-overlay
tokens.usage: Dialog scrim and dialog.

tokens.name: z-toast
tokens.usage: Copied / Published toasts.

tokens.name: opacity-resolved
tokens.usage: A comment card the mentee marked as fixed.

tokens.name: opacity-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled controls that cannot use a token pair instead.
